source: RESEARCH_PRELIMINARY_FREEZE_V0_2.md with original section 5 two-pass rule

selection.order: SHA256 hex ascending, then exact hash-input string ascending
passes: first eligible group per game in hash order up to six
second group per game in the same hash order until six
selection.final_order: pass-1 selections followed by pass-2 selections; do not globally reorder afterward
selection.eligible: validated complete or policy-failed, measurement-valid physical N/P rollout; exact first action differs from source D draft; at least ten audited new continuation logical calls
selection.counting: actual shared N=P counts once; off-menu separately executed groups stay separate but same-as-D action is never an eligible intervention
selection.shortage: retain the fixed per-game and total caps; coverage_insufficient; no threshold reduction or short-tail replacement

content: original first_actions with prediction and score evidence
canonical hashes of source rollout, full continuation ledger and source deployment
frozen_event.sha256: canonical JSON object excluding its own sha256 field

deployment.config_sha256_scope: canonical target inference configuration; execution package must expose and validate its exact content
deployment.runner_effective_config_sha256: separate full runner config digest; source must bind manifest.effective_config_sha256; endpoint differences need not match across jobs
deployment.physical_uuid: recorded independently on both sides; different whole cards allowed within the admitted class

comparison.method: first causal hard divergence over the existing chronological evidence; keep earlier numeric diagnostics
hard_fields: cached first action and actual physical group
submitted request plus actual messages and parameters
action, observation, ordered menu, done, success
comparison.numeric_precision: exact canonical JSON equality; no rounding and no nonzero tolerance
comparison.numeric_only: only after the full available path is hard-field identical; insufficient_evidence with raw-ledger and terminal hashes
comparison.numeric_before_later_hard_divergence: retain numeric findings and classify the first hard divergence; do not hide a later text/request/environment mismatch
comparison.raw_outcomes: preserved independently from measurement validity and stop disposition

stops.recovery_or_configuration_mismatch: one bounded existing-evidence review; fix in new version and revalidate or end stage unresolved
stops.backend_output_divergence: one bounded deployment/sampling review; no hardware-only automatic stochastic acceptance
stops.environment_transition_mismatch: one bounded environment/assets/recovery review; fix or end stage unresolved
stops.numeric_evidence_only: exact evidence retained; bounded numeric review; no implicit tolerance or automatic continuation
stops.coverage_insufficient: report fixed-pool coverage; unresolved until explicitly bounded later disposition, never automatic pass

reporting.receipt_order: chronological prefix of frozen selection order; reject a receipt after a prior stop

still_required_in_execution_package: Q8 actual quotas and resource limits
service and hardware admission with raw evidence
source and replay artifact handoff and per-group stop wiring
